notes.title: Tutorial system is renewed!
notes.notes:
Update Notes for 2022.03.31
version - 1.2.4

<Tutorial system is renewed!>

Tutorial system is renewed.
Quest location search function is added.
Interaction tutorial is added.
New quest UI and story tutorial quests are added.
Main menu can be closed during NPC interaction.
NPC no longer obstructs the view.
Pop-up image and message are improved.

And now...
You can also download Galaxity : Korea AR from the App Store!
Have a fascinating experience where VR users and Mobile users meet in one space!

notes.title: Now, you can play Galaxity : Korea on Android mobile AR now!
notes.notes:
Update Notes for 2022.01.28
version - 1.2.2

<Now, you can play Galaxity : Korea on Android mobile AR now!>

Are you enjoying your life in Galaxity : Korea?
Today, I'm here to tell you some amazing news! Drum roll, please~
That is, you can enjoy Galaxity : Korea with AR!
Go to Myeongdong and Jejudo right now and play the Galaxity : Korea AR app!
Then you'll be able to meet friends who are connected through VR.
Of course, you can decorate your avatar in a variety of ways in the AR world.
Galaxity : Korea AR can be downloaded from the Google Play Store!

<And... A lot of other functions have been added and improved!>

functions added
A close button has been added to the chat window with NPC in Jeju.

functions improved
The conversation contents and script improved in Jeju.

Bugs fixed
Some bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Enjoy the new region 'JEJU ISLAND', as a costume.
notes.notes:
<Update Notes for 2022.01.03>

The new costume has been updated to commemorate the update of Jeju Island, a new region.
Decorate your avatar with various costumes, including 'dolhareubang', which symbolizes Jeju Island!

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]A NEW SPOT, JEJU ISLAND, has been added to Galaxity : Korea![/b]

[b]"Ramsar wetland protected area, Dongbaek dongsan in Jeju Island"[/b]
You can visit Seoul and Jeju Island at any time you want on the World Map of Galaxity : Korea.
In Dongbaek dongsan of Jeju Island, you can easily hear the explanation and story of the Dongbaek dongsan Wetland Center through text and voice.
And also if you move to Meonmulkkak, the representative wetland of Dongbaek dongsan, you can hear the explanation while looking at the Meonmulkkak in front of you.
Enjoy the green and beautiful scenery and get some rest of your mind in nature.
Items that can only be purchased at stores in Dongbaek dongsan in Jeju Island can't be overlooked!
You can decorate your avatar by choosing items that go well with exploring Meonmulkkak wetlands or taking a walk in the wetland center.

Now, In Jeju Island, take a leisurely walk around the Dongbaek dongsan and the Meonmulkkak and make wonderful memories with your friends from all over the world!
